name: AI Respo

sources.title: Homepage — live AI tools directory with categories, reviews, and blog (~400+ tools)
Submit AI Tool For Free — login-required form; manual review; published within 30 days; acceptance criteria listed

conditions: Free submission requires a registered account — form is behind login ('Login Required to Submit'; Google sign-in or free registration)
requirements: Must be a standalone product (not a feature), with its own pricing, preferably a dedicated website
Authentic website — no impersonation, no domain squatting
Secure HTTPS URL pointing to the tool's homepage; functional, malware-free site
preparation: Account on airespo.com (email registration or Continue with Google)
Tool name, homepage URL, clear description ('informative and well-crafted descriptions attract interest')
Category fit (Business, Communication/Chat, Content Creation, Development, Education, Entertainment, Health, etc.)
workflow: Register or log in at airespo.com (free account)
Open https://airespo.com/submit-tool/ and complete all required fields
Submit — manual review follows; approved tools are listed within 30 days
To manage an existing listing, claim it first, then edit directly; or email support with the tool name and changes
watchFor: 30-day review horizon — not a fast launch channel
No paid featured listings or sponsorships exist — featured picks are editorial discretion only
All form fields are required; nothing about the form is optional per the page
Claim-first model: if the tool is already listed, claim it before editing
WordPress-style site — do not expect high domain authority
countsAsLive: The tool appears at airespo.com/ai-tools/<slug>/ inside a category, visible in the directory index
